embeds.title: 🟡 Microsoft Fixes BitLocker Recovery Issue Only for Windows 11 Users
embeds.description:
Microsoft addressed a known issue causing some Windows 11 systems to boot into BitLocker recovery after installing the April 2026 Windows security updates. The issue affects Windows 10, Windows 11, and Windows Server devices with an unrecommended BitLocker Group Policy configuration. Microsoft fixed the issue with KB5089549 cumulative update for Windows 11 25H2, but Windows 10 and Windows Server customers must wait for a future update. The issue is unlikely to affect personal devices as affected configurations are typically found only on enterprise systems.
